classes.name: IGESConvGeom
classes.summary: This package is intended to gather geometric conversion which are not immediate but can be used for several purposes : mainly, standard conversion to and from CasCade geometric and topologic data, and adaptations of IGES files as required (as replacing Spline entities to BSpline equivalents).

staticMethods.name: SplineCurveFromIGES
staticMethods.signature: (igesent: IGESGeom_SplineCurve, epscoef: number, epsgeom: number): { returnValue: number; result: Geom_BSplineCurve; [Symbol.dispose](): void }
staticMethods.comment:
basic tool to build curves from {@link IGESGeom | `IGESGeom`} (arrays of points, Transformations, evaluation of points in a datum) Converts a SplineCurve from IGES to a BSplineCurve from CasCade <epscoef> gives tolerance to consider coefficient to be nul <epsgeom> gives tolerance to consider poles to be equal The returned value is a status with these possible values :
- 0 OK, done
- 1 the result is not guaranteed to be C0 (with <epsgeom>)
- 2 SplineType not processed (allowed : max 3) (no result produced)
- 3 error during creation of control points (no result produced)
- 4 polynomial equation is not correct (no result produced)
- 5 less than one segment (no result produced)
@returns A result object with fields:
- `returnValue`: the C++ return value
- `result`: owned by the returned envelope.
Dispose the returned envelope to release owned Handle fields.

staticMethods.name: IncreaseCurveContinuity
staticMethods.signature: (curve: Geom_BSplineCurve, epsgeom: number, continuity: number): number
staticMethods.comment: Tries to increase curve continuity with tolerance <epsgeom> <continuity> is the new desired continuity, can be 1 or 2 (more than 2 is considered as 2). Returns the new maximum continuity obtained on all knots. Remark that, for instance with <continuity> = 2, even if not all the knots can be passed to C2, all knots which can be are.

staticMethods.name: IncreaseCurveContinuity
staticMethods.signature: (curve: Geom2d_BSplineCurve, epsgeom: number, continuity: number): number

staticMethods.name: SplineSurfaceFromIGES
staticMethods.signature: (igesent: IGESGeom_SplineSurface, epscoef: number, epsgeom: number): { returnValue: number; result: Geom_BSplineSurface; [Symbol.dispose](): void }
staticMethods.comment:
Converts a SplineSurface from IGES to a BSplineSurface from CasCade <epscoef> gives tolerance to consider coefficient to be nul <epsgeom> gives tolerance to consider poles to be equal The returned value is a status with these possible values :
- 0 OK, done
- 1 the result is not guaranteed to be C0 (with <epsgeom>)
- 2 degree is not compatible with code boundary type (warning) but C0 is OK
- 3 idem but C0 is not guaranteed (warning)
- 4 degree has been determined to be nul, either in U or V (no result produced)
- 5 less than one segment in U or V (no result produced)
@returns A result object with fields:
- `returnValue`: the C++ return value
- `result`: owned by the returned envelope.
Dispose the returned envelope to release owned Handle fields.

staticMethods.name: IncreaseSurfaceContinuity
staticMethods.signature: (surface: Geom_BSplineSurface, epsgeom: number, continuity?: number): number
staticMethods.comment: Tries to increase Surface continuity with tolerance <epsgeom> <continuity> is the new desired continuity, can be 1 or 2 (more than 2 is considered as 2). Returns the new maximum continuity obtained on all knots. Remark that, for instance with <continuity> = 2, even if not all the knots can be passed to C2, all knots which can be are.

classes.name: IGESConvGeom_GeomBuilder
classes.summary: This class provides some useful basic tools to build {@link IGESGeom | `IGESGeom`} curves, especially : define a curve in a plane in 3D space (ex. Circular or Conic arc, or Copious Data defined in 2D) make a CopiousData from a list of points/vectors.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a GeomBuilder at initial state.

instanceMethods.name: Clear
instanceMethods.comment: Clears list of Points/Vectors and data about Transformation.

instanceMethods.name: AddXY
instanceMethods.comment: Adds a XY (Z=0) to the list of points.

instanceMethods.name: AddXYZ
instanceMethods.comment: Adds a XYZ to the list of points.

instanceMethods.name: AddVec
instanceMethods.comment: Adds a Vector part to the list of points. It will be used for CopiousData, datatype=3, only. AddXY and AddXYZ consider a null vector part (0,0,0) AddVec adds to the last added XY or XYZ.

instanceMethods.name: NbPoints
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the count of already recorded points.

instanceMethods.name: Point
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a point given its rank (if added as XY, Z will be 0).

instanceMethods.name: MakeCopiousData
instanceMethods.comment: Makes a CopiousData with the list of recorded Points/Vectors according to <datatype>, which must be 1,2 or 3 If <polyline> is given True, the CopiousData is coded as a Polyline, but <datatype> must not be 3 <datatype> = 1 : Common Z is computed as average of all Z <datatype> = 1 or 2 : Vectors are ignored.

instanceMethods.name: Position
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Position in which the method EvalXYZ will evaluate a XYZ. It can be regarded as defining a local system. It is initially set to Identity.

instanceMethods.name: SetPosition
instanceMethods.comment: Sets final position from an already defined Trsf.

instanceMethods.name: SetPosition
instanceMethods.comment: Sets final position from an Ax3.

instanceMethods.name: SetPosition
instanceMethods.comment: Sets final position from an Ax2.

instanceMethods.name: SetPosition
instanceMethods.comment: Sets final position from an Ax1 (this means that origin point and Z-axis are defined, the other axes are defined arbitrarily).

instanceMethods.name: IsIdentity
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the Position is Identity.

instanceMethods.name: IsTranslation
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the Position is a Translation only Remark : Identity and ZOnly will answer True.

instanceMethods.name: IsZOnly
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the Position corresponds to a Z-Displacement, i.e. is a Translation only, and only on Z Remark : Identity will answer True.

instanceMethods.name: EvalXYZ
instanceMethods.signature: (val: gp_XYZ, X: number, Y: number, Z: number): { X: number; Y: number; Z: number }
instanceMethods.returnType: { X: number; Y: number; Z: number }
instanceMethods.comment:
Evaluates a XYZ value in the Position already defined. Returns the transformed coordinates. For a 2D definition, X,Y will then be used to define a XY and Z will be regarded as a Z Displacement (can be ignored).
@returns A result object with fields:
- `X`: updated value from the call.
- `Y`: updated value from the call.
- `Z`: updated value from the call.

instanceMethods.name: MakeTransformation
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the IGES Transformation which corresponds to the Position. Even if it is an Identity : IsIdentity should be tested first. <unit> is the unit value in which the model is created : it is used to convert translation part.
